# Sirach Chapter 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 19 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_019_page_001.jpg

---

**19:1** A worker who is a drunkard will not become rich; one who despises small things will fall little by little.

**19:2** Wine and women lead astray even the intelligent, and the man who clings to prostitutes is more reckless.

**19:3** Decay and worms will inherit him, and a reckless soul will be cut off.

**19:4** One who trusts quickly is shallow-minded, and one who sins wrongs himself.

**19:5** One who rejoices in wickedness will be condemned, and one who hates gossip has less evil.

**19:6** Whoever repeats a word is a tattletale — do not trust such a person, and what you say to them will not stay with them.

**19:7** Do not repeat what you hear, and you will lose nothing.

**19:8** Do not tell it to friend or foe; and unless it is a sin for you, do not reveal it.

**19:9** For someone has heard you and watched you, and when the time comes he will hate you.

**19:10** Have you heard something? Let it die with you. Be strong — it will not burst you.

**19:11** From hearing a word a fool will writhe in pain, like a woman in labor from a child.

**19:12** Like an arrow stuck in the flesh of the thigh, so is a word inside a fool.

**19:13** Reprove a friend — perhaps he did not do it; and if he did something, so that he may not do it again.

**19:14** Reprove your neighbor — perhaps he did not say it; and if he did say it, so that he may not say it again.

**19:15** Reprove a friend — for often there is slander; and do not trust every word.

**19:16** There is one who slips and does not sin; and who has not sinned with the tongue?

**19:17** Reprove your neighbor before making threats; and give place to the law of the Most High.

**19:18** The whole of wisdom is the fear of the LORD, and in all wisdom is the doing of the law.

**19:19** The knowledge of wickedness is not wisdom, and the plan of sinners is not prudence.

**19:20** There is a cleverness that is detestable, and there is a person who lacks wisdom yet knows how to be just.

**19:21** There is one who is limited in understanding but fears God; and there is one who has much intelligence but transgresses the law.

**19:22** There is cunning cleverness that is iniquitous, and there is one who distorts justice in order to win favor.

**19:23** There is a scoundrel bowed down in mourning, but inwardly he is full of deceit.

**19:24** He hides his face and pretends not to hear; but when no one is watching, he will get ahead of you.

**19:25** And even if for lack of power he is kept from sinning, if he finds an opportunity he will do harm.

**19:26** From his appearance a man is recognized, and from the meeting of his face a person of understanding is known.

**19:27** A man's dress and his gaping laughter, and his way of walking, show what he is.

**19:28** There is a reprover who rebukes falsely, and there is one who judges unjustly; and there is one who acts deceitfully yet acquits the innocent.

**19:29** There is one who commits iniquity while humbling himself greatly, but inwardly he is full of deceit.

**19:30** There is one who bows down in great humility, whose interior is full of deceit —
